thesis: Formal definitions, metaphor translations and practical exercises turn intuition into testable skill.
role: Use the appendices as a bridge to implementation rather than an extra inventory in the short essay.

ideas.statement: The formulas make loss, optimization, attention, memory operations, metrics and privacy precise in terms already introduced by the narrative.
The metaphor dictionary supports technical reading, and the suggested practical path starts with simple baselines, then networks, retrieval and a private evaluation set.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: The suggested first experiment compares a ruler, tree and boosted ensemble before adding complexity.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Collecting resources is not the same as learning; every exercise retains sealed tests and checks of user-relevant errors.

audit.notes: Entire assigned segment reviewed; scope and qualifications preserved. Duplicate contents and publication metadata are not ranked as ideas.
